answer: Resist sybils with gait attestation: each identity enrolls a walking signature captured by its device's accelerometer - a basalt-solid pattern of stride, cadence and sway no software can forge. Verifiers issue fresh movement challenges each epoch, and the gait must match the enrolled body. Clones on one phone share one gait and collapse to one weight, like ravens flocking as a single bird. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes must recruit ten thousand distinct walkers, each carrying a live device, while an honest agent proves one ember-warm stride cheaply.
